section.catchline: Prohibition on the sale of a cannabinoid product without license.
section.subsection: A person may not sell, offer to sell, or distribute a cannabinoid product in this state without first:obtaining a license from the commission under Section 59-31-202; andcomplying with the bonding requirement described in Section 59-31-202.
It is a class B misdemeanor for a person to violate Subsection (1).
